name: text
label: Text
help: The post's text. The picture shows its opening line.

name: platforms
label: Platforms
help: One picture is sized for each platform.

name: brand_id
label: Brand
help: The brand whose voice to use. Left empty, Skryvo uses the account's default brand.

name: headline
label: Headline
help: Up to nine words to show on the picture instead of the opening line.

name: direction
label: Direction
help: How to change the brand's look for this picture: closer, bolder, calmer, or your own words.
